revisions.title: Love Requires a Test
revisions.body: The question is not whether an action is performed, but whether it deserves praise. Pausanias makes the same distinction for love: an action is neither noble nor shameful in itself, and its manner of performance determines how it is judged; only the love that prompts noble action merits encomium.
